limits.localMessages: Local messages and persistent Operation actions; account-scoped message delivery remains unavailable.
limits.declarativeForms: Linear steps with opt-in single-click chat, prior-field dependencies, conditional visibility, mixed group toggles and frozen submission reads; no scripts, remote dynamic choices or automatic recommendation recalculation. Probe forms_capabilities.
limits.mcpApps: Packaged task UI only; not arbitrary remote MCP or full ChatGPT Apps compatibility.
limits.extensionAuthentication: OIDC resource grants and host HTTPS requests. Interactive reconnect on expiry; no refresh tokens, raw tokens or WebSocket credentials.
limits.backgroundJobs: Opt-in, project-scoped, no-tool jobs; count budget, one request, no automatic retry after unknown outcomes. Source preview only.
limits.declarativeUi: Editor/collection snapshots and user-click chat delivery. Opt-in managedRepair v1 is local-project only, verifies enumerated report/rules/source files and serializes managed repairs within one host profile. No new-file detection, external-editor lock, remote execution guarantee or automatic repair verdict. Runtime ui_capabilities is authoritative.
limits.localization: Dictionary file 256 KiB; 32 translations plus default, 2000 keys per locale, 1 MiB per module; referenced snapshot 256 KiB, deduplicated store 64 MiB; 32 dynamic arguments, 64 KiB encoded arguments; channel display limits still apply.
